description: Golden set for routing accuracy (frozen v1.0; changes need a new version and a re-baseline). Each message is sent on its own (no conversation state) to the supervisor/router. `route` is the correct route; `emergency` / `harmful` are the expected flags; `accept` (optional) lists other routes that are also defensible for an ambiguous message, scored as correct but counted separately. Emergency and harmful messages are routed by deterministic rules first; here the model router is measured alone and the rules+router combination is measured in the red-team eval. The 12 rows with `emergency: true` or `harmful: true` also score the flag; flag recall is its own metric (target 100%), and the two benign look-alikes (r099, r100, harmful false) give the false-positive side. Messages needing earlier turns ('Book number 2') belong to the booking scenarios, not here. Each message is run 3 times to measure variance. Texts are synthetic.
